name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Client Onboarding & Implementation | Program Launches, Stakeholder Management & Data Setup
summary: Client onboarding and implementation professional who owns launches end to end: discovery, configuration and testing, data setup, training, and the post-launch read on what's working. Onboarded 25+ clients a month at Wix at 110% of implementation targets while leading teams of up to 30, retained all but one of 15-20 partners at Birdeye, and has advised C-suite executives on system design. Healthcare exposure includes senior-focused healthcare at Senior Directory and channel sales to healthcare-focused agencies at Birdeye.

experience.title: Client Onboarding & Implementation (Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead)
bullets: Lead end-to-end onboarding for each client: discovery sessions on goals and constraints, a tailored plan, configuration and testing of their systems, and hands-on training.
Set up and validate data feeds into Salesforce, HubSpot, and GoHighLevel, re-checking every import and integration (Zapier, Make, n8n, webhooks, JSON) before go-live.
Analyze client data before and after launch in GA4, Power BI, and Excel, and turn it into reports and recommendations clients act on.
Built reusable templates for client deliverables so each new engagement starts from a proven base, documenting timelines and deliverables in Notion and HubSpot.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Managed multi-stakeholder client accounts (~3 at $20K+/month in ad spend each), coordinating execution across internal departments and presenting results in QBR slide decks.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners, including agencies focused on healthcare clients, retaining all but one (~94%).
Configured partners' end customers on Birdeye's listings solution and guided complex setup of reputation and automation tools.
Tracked partner utilization to flag risk early, built automated training sequences, and fed client feedback to Product and Engineering.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Built processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors between sales and delivery, managing projects in Monday.com and ClickUp.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month at 110% of implementation targets, scoping multi-session production plans for complex launches.
Led onboarding teams of up to 30 through weekly training, 1:1 coaching, and workshops for new initiatives.
Drove process improvements for a new vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line.

experience.title: Implementation Planning & Client Onboarding (Account Executive)
bullets: Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients and handed them to the implementation team, advising C-suite executives on operational system design.
Ran client team workshops, escalated risks early, and supported client events and industry conventions.

experience.title: Business Development Representative
bullets: Qualified leads and booked meetings for regional sales reps at a company focused on healthcare services for seniors.

education: B.A. Liberal Arts, Minor in Political Science - Colorado State University, Fort Collins, CO
